detail.longDescription: Meta has shifted to a new flagship AI model called Muse Spark and sent the Llama "herd" of models to the farm upstate. It's a dramatic but understandable shift in AI strategy from the company that was once pioneering open models. Muse Spark is a multimodal reasoning model, and unlike the Llama models, it's a closed-weight proprietary model. You won't be able to download it from Hugging Face or run it on your own machine for any reason. There are several other AI products also under the Muse ban
